verdict.rationale: mParticle supports background-running data pipelines—audiences, real-time forwarding rules, and Feeds—that operate continuously once configured (mparticle-docs-19, mparticle-docs-25, mparticle-docs-28, mparticle-docs-x2, mparticle-docs-x4), which functions as a form of autonomous background automation for data activation. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific automation setup, triggers/scheduling controls, or an AI-native interface for configuring these automations beyond the natural-language audience description feature (mparticle-docs-16, mparticle-docs-22). Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-driven automation creation/monitoring, scheduling/trigger configuration details, and independent corroboration that these run fully autonomously without manual oversight.
